api: mpv_create; mpv_initialize; mpv_command(loadfile, local tagged MP3 path); mpv_wait_event(MPV_EVENT_FILE_LOADED); mpv_get_property_string(metadata/by-key/title, track-list/0/type and codec); mpv_get_property(duration), called from a C++17 translation unit

build_dependencies.role: required by mpv 0.42.0 (>= 7.387.0); renderer only, not called by the null video output
required by mpv; subtitle renderer, not instrumented

valid_variant_note: Same MPEG audio frames as the control under an ID3v2.4 tag (synchsafe frame sizes, UTF-8 text, no padding) instead of ID3v2.3 (Latin-1 text, padding), so the difference exercises FFmpeg's ID3v2 reader rather than the audio path
coverage: LLVM source coverage in the pinned mpv 0.42.0 demuxer layer (demux/demux_lavf.c) and the FFmpeg 9.0.2 libavformat sources it calls, including the ID3v2 reader (id3v2.c) and MP3 demuxer (mp3dec.c), built from source with the same instrumentation and linked into a C++17 byte-input harness that loads a local file through libmpv's loadfile command
family: libmpv demux_lavf wrapper over FFmpeg ID3v2 reader and MP3 demuxer
parser_family: FFmpeg 9.0.2 ID3v2 reader (libavformat/id3v2.c) and MP3 demuxer (libavformat/mp3dec.c) behind libmpv 0.42.0 demux/demux_lavf.c. FFmpeg is configured with mp3 as its only demuxer, so no other FFmpeg demuxer can claim the input
shared_parser_family: FFmpeg 9.0.2 ID3v2 reader and MP3 demuxer behind libmpv 0.42.0 demux/demux_lavf.c
shared_parser_family_note: Same pinned mpv, FFmpeg and libplacebo archives, configure options and static libmpv build as projects/mp3_id3v2/c/mpv; only the call site differs (C++17 with RAII ownership). The FFmpeg rows parse with the same id3v2.c and mp3dec.c release directly, without libmpv. mpv has no ID3v2 parser of its own. This is not an independent parser.
